items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: And he come to see me when I was flat on my back from my final operation

ctx.x: And that's what he did. And behind that

he lost his wife. She passed. And he'd begin to say, here, now, he's back in New York, and he's doing fine. I tell you who loved him really, Archie Moore really loved Lucky. He was willing to put some money behind him and everything to make him go.

And he come to see me when I was flat on my back from my final operation, when I was living in Long Island at the time. And he was (inaudible) -- and he's just like Lucky's (inaudible). You know how you can get?
